"''You have no idea.|Bo-Katan Kryze and Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} In the wake of the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective's]] coup against the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]], a '''battle''' was fought in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the New [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] faction on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Early fighting broke out as members of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] who had turned against [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]—leader of the Shadow Collective—attempted to free the deposed former leader of the New Mandalorians, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] from her [[Royal prison/Legends|captivity]]. Kryze was able to make it outside of the [[Domed city/Legends|domed city]] and send a request for aid to her one time lover, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], before being recaptured and returned to [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. With word of the recent events on Mandalore, Kenobi journeyed to Mandalore to assist Kryze, leading to further fighting as he attempted to evacuate the jailed duchess from Sundari. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was destroyed over [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|Sundari's docks]], and he was captured alongside Kryze by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Maul and a cadre of his loyal [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commandos]]. Kryze was subsequently [[Shiak|murdered]] by Maul as part of his vengeance against Kenobi for the Jedi nearly [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|killing]] him ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior, and Kenobi was delivered to Sundari's prison in order to live with the emotional pain from his former lover's [[Death/Legends|death]]. Before he could ever reach the cell intended for him, Kenobi was rescued by [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze]], Satine Kryze's estranged [[Clan Kryze/Legends|sister]] and the leader of the faction of Death Watch that refused to serve Darth Maul. Kenobi and Bo-Katan moved to flee from Sundari, battling Maul's pursuing super [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] all the way out of the city, before navigating the chaos of a larger conflict that had taken shape at Sundari's docks. Bo-Katan's loyal [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] clashed with Maul's [[Troop/Legends|troops]] in a heated battle, holding back the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] forces in order to allow Kenobi to hurry aboard a [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|''Kom'rk''-class transport]] and get off planet. At the same [[Time/Legends|time]] Kenobi was attempting to get off of Mandalore, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] had arrived on the planet, seeking to confront his former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] Darth Maul. Sidious came face to face with Maul in the throne room of the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]], [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaging]] Maul and his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] that ended with Opress dead at the hands of Sidious, while Maul was [[Force lightning/Legends|subdued]] by his former [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] but spared for Darth Sidious' future purposes. ==Prelude== {{Quote|I claim this sword, and my rightful place as leader of Death Watch!''"
"''Never! No outsider will ''ever'' rule Mandalore!''"
"''If you will not join me, you will ''all'' die.''"
"''You're all traitors!''"
"''Unfortunately for you, history will not see it that way. Execute them!|Darth Maul and Bo-Katan Kryze|}} In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] territory throughout the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], in which the pacifistic people made their home,''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]'' was [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|overrun]] by the criminal assembly known as the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]]. Across the New [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]' [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], gangsters from [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], the [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Spice dealer/Legends|dealing]] [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], and the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartels]] [[Blaster/Legends|gunned]] down [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|police]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and civilians alike in order to cause panic. At the height of the people's desperation, the renegade Mandalorian group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] came forward to defend the New Mandalorians against the offworld [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]]; unknown to the public, [[Death/Legends|Death]] Watch was secretly in league with the criminals besieging Sundari, having forged an alliance with their leader, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], in order to topple the New Mandalorian [[Ruling Council (New Mandalorians)/Legends|government]]. Throughout the city, Death Watch systematically defeated and arrested the aggressors, winning the favor of the New Mandalorian populous. With the will of the people on their side, Death Watch marched into the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]] and there, the group's leader [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] deposed the ruler of the New Mandalorians, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. Kryze, [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Armatan/Legends|Armatan]], and the other New Mandalorian leaders were [[Royal prison/Legends|imprisoned]], while Vizsla replaced the former duchess as [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']], the traditional ruler of the Mandalorians. [[File:AlmecDeathWatch-ShadesOfReason.png|thumb|left|300px|Prime Minister [[Almec/Legends|Almec]] stands before the people of Sundari, flanked by [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] troopers]] Vizsla's reign proved short, however. With his own goals met, Death Watch's [[Commander/Legends|commander]] turned upon his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ally, and had both [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Maul and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] jailed. Maul had foreseen Vizsla's betrayal, and planned for it: easily [[The Force/Legends|freeing]] themselves from their cell, within the [[Prison/Legends|prison's]] walls the two Sith came across the former New Mandalorian Prime Minister, [[Almec/Legends|Almec]], who had been arrested on charges of [[Mandalorian black market conspiracy/Legends|corruption]]. Selecting Almec as a suitable replacement for Vizsla in his schemes, Maul broke free of the prison and stormed the Royal Palace, where he challenged Vizsla to a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] for the right to lead. Honor-bound by the [[Canons of Honor|ancient codes]] Death Watch and Vizsla venerated, the Mandalorian leader [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaged]] the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] in a furious battle throughout the throne room, though he ultimately could not match Darth Maul's prowess. Vizsla was [[Sai cha/Legends|slain]], and Maul proclaimed himself to be the ''Mand'alor'' and leader of Death Watch, yet he was not met with unanimous approval: Vizsla's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze]], refused to follow a non-Mandalorian, and she fled the palace with a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of other like-minded [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] amidst a hail of [[Lightfight|blasterfire]]. Almec was instituted as the new Prime Minister, a puppet ruler to who would publicly lead in the place of Darth Maul, while the Sith Lord remained in the shadows, unknown to the populous. ==The battle== ===Early skirmishes=== {{Quote|Get the Duchess clear!|Bo-Katan Kryze, while under fire from Darth Maul loyalists|}} [[File:RescueofSatine.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Duchess Kryze flees Sundari, pursued by the Death Watch]] [[Standard week/Legends|Weeks]] after Darth Maul's rise to power, Bo-Katan was able to infiltrate the prison where Satine—her estranged [[Clan Kryze/Legends|sister]]—was being held. Together with her nephew [[Korkie Kryze/Legends|Korkie Kryze]] and a [[Amis/Legends|group]] of his [[Soniee/Legends|close]] [[Lagos/Legends|friends]], Bo-Katan freed Satine and rushed her to a waiting [[Buirk'alor-class airspeeder|''Buirk'alor''-class airspeeder]],''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' intending to flee the city escorted by a cadre of Death Watch soldiers still loyal to Bo-Katan. Not far from the prison complex, however, the [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] was spotted by one of the [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commandos]] loyal to Maul{{SWE|groups|mandalorian-super-commando|Mandalorian super commando}} and quickly came under attack. A brief shootout ensued between the two groups of Mandalorian warriors, with Bo-Katan staying behind to stave off the attackers while Korkie continued onward toward Sundari's outer [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|docks]]. Despite the efforts of Death Watch to stall the Maul loyalists, the speeder shuttling the former Duchess Kryze was struck and damaged by blasterfire, necessitating a crash landing at the docks. In the midst of a firefight between her nephew's friends and the super [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] that had pursued her to the docks, Kryze transmitted a request for aid to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the hope that it might reach her friend and one-time lover, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Kryze was shortly surrounded and recaptured, taken back to her cell at the prison, though her message would indeed find its way to the intended recipient. With word of the criminal takeover on Mandalore, Obi-Wan Kenobi set out for Mandalore; alone and acting without support from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] due to [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore's]] status as a neutral [[Star system/Legends|system]], Kenobi arrived at Sundari aboard an old [[Twilight/Legends|freighter]] borrowed from his former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Stealing a suit of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] from one of Maul's soldiers, Kenobi sneaked into the city and infiltrated the prison where Satine Kryze was being held, freeing the deposed leader from her cell and stealing a [[Balutar-class swoop/Legends|''Balutar''-class swoop bike]] on which the two then made their escape. Pursued by a Maul-loyalist commandos, as Kenobi and Kryze reached the docks they hastily boarded Kenobi's waiting [[Starship/Legends|starship]], and made use of its onboard [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] to defend against the Mandalorian attackers as they lifted off. Once in the air, however, the ship was struck by a pair of [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] fired by the enemy soldiers, causing it to crash and both Kryze and Kenobi to be violently ejected onto the docks while attempting to jump clear of the wreckage. [[Telekinesis/Legends|Subdued]] by the arrival of Darth Maul at the docks, Kenobi and Kryze were taken back into custody and delivered to the Royal Palace. There, intent to make Kenobi suffer for the wounds he had [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|sustained]] at the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Limb/Legends|hands]] nearly a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] prior, Maul [[Shiak|murdered]] Kenobi's former lover before his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and left the Jedi Master to mourn Kryze's death on his way to prison, preferring to let Kenobi live with his pain than kill him outright. ===Conflict escalates=== {{Quote|Sorry, I don't believe we've met. You are…?''"
"''Bo-Katan. I'm here to rescue you. That's all you need to know.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Bo-Katan Kryze|}} [[File:NiteOwlsAndKenobi-TheLawless.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The [[Nite Owls/Legends|Nite Owls]] defend Obi-Wan Kenobi from Maul's super commandos]] As Obi-Wan Kenobi was being [[Hover taxi|transported]] to Sundari's prison, his team of guards came under attack by Bo-Katan Kryze and a unit of the faction of Death Watch that refused to surrender to Darth Maul's authority. One by one, the Sith loyalists were killed in a brief skirmish, and Kryze freed Kenobi, offering him a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] to make use of in order to escape Sundari. Shortly after taking off from the prison, Kenobi's escort were assaulted by a pursuing unit of Maul's soldiers, who had been alerted by Maul due to him sensing Kenobi's escape. Kryze's [[Troop/Legends|troops]] formed a rear guard, firing backward onto the attackers as the in-flight battle reached an egress to Sundari's outer docks. There, Kenobi, Kryze, and her soldiers elected to make a stand, landing and opening fire on the super commandos from solid ground. Several members of Kryze's [[Nite Owls/Legends|Nite Owls]]—a unit of soldiers handpicked by the Death Watch lieutenant—primed gauntlet-mounted [[Shield gauntlet/Legends|portable energy shields]] to defend themselves, while another struck at their foes with a jetpack-launched missile. Suffering losses as quickly as they were inflicting them, Maul's warriors moved to close the gap between themselves and Kryze's troops, and the fight quickly turned to a close-quarters [[Unarmed combat/Legends|melee]] from which Kryze's soldiers emerged victorious. [[File:BoKatan-Kenobi_BattleOfSundari.png|thumb|right|300px|Bo-Katan and Obi-Wan Kenobi fight together in the battle on Sundari's docks]] Pushing out of the city and onto Sundari's docks, Kryze and Kenobi found themselves in the midst of a larger battle between the portion of the Death Watch that had sided with Bo-Katan, and the others who had pledged their service to Darth Maul. Across the docks, Mandalorians clashed with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and fists in equal measure, as ''Kom'rk''-class fighters battled in the skies over Sundari. One of the ''Kom'rk'' fighters slowed to a halt over the docks, decanting Death Watch soldiers equipped with jetpacks from the ship's ventral drop bay to aid Kryze's ground forces, only for the vessel to be shot out of the air moments later by their former comrades. While Mandalorians on both sides flew overhead, trading blaster shots and striking their enemies with their [[Armor/Legends|armored]] bodies, Kryze rushed Obi-Wan Kenobi to the docks edge and a waiting ''Kom'rk'' fighter prepared to take the Jedi Master offworld. In their final moments together, Kenobi deduced Bo-Katan's familial relationship with his deceased former lover and offered his condolences. Kryze, in turn, advised Kenobi to inform the Republic of Maul's presence on Mandalore, preferring the prospects of a Republic invasion over allowing a Sith Lord to rule the New Mandalorians. With those last words, and his condolences for her sister's death, Kenobi boarded the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] and was taken from Sundari, leaving Kryze behind to continue the fight. ===Showdown in the palace=== {{Quote|Remember, the first and only reality of the Sith: there can only be ''two.'' And ''you'' are no longer my apprentice. You have been replaced.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] taunting Darth Maul|}} At the same time Obi-Wan Kenobi was being freed from his captors by the Death Watch troops loyal to Bo-Katan Kryze, an [[Eta-class shuttle/Legends|''Eta''-class shuttle]] [[Darth Sidious' Eta-class shuttle/Legends|belonging]] to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] over Mandalore and made its approach toward Sundari. The Dark Lord had sensed his one time apprentice and tracked his whereabouts to Mandalore, intent to confront the rogue Sith, having deemed Maul's growing power to be too dangerous. Setting down at the docks, Sidious was confronted by two super commandos whom he immediately caught in a telekinetic choke-hold before taking a speeder to the Palace. In the throne room, Darth Maul sensed a familiar presence and was realized that it was Sidious. At that moment, the commandos flanking the door were suddenly lifted into the air and strangled as Sidious strode in. Maul knelt before him, proclaiming to have conquered the New Mandalorians in an effort to prove himself worthy to rejoin his former [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]]. However, with an apprentice of his own in his brother Savage Opress, and a budding criminal empire in the form of the Shadow Collective, Maul was now a rival, so Sidious pushed Maul and Opress into the vaulted windows with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] initiating a two-against-one [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] duel. [[File:SidiousVsMaulSavage-TL.png|thumb|left|300px|[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] faces off against [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] at the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]]]] Sidious broke the saber lock by first attacking Maul, then Savage. The younger brother jumped back while Savage slipped trying to defend himself. After a brief pause, Maul initiated an offensive on Sidious, but the more experienced Dark Lord of the Sith merely blocked his powerful strikes and attempted a sweeping slash, but Maul jumped back to his brother. Sidious strode through the throne room quietly; as Maul and Savage attempted to attack him, Sidious telekinetically threw the brothers back to the opposite wall, then unleashed a fierce barrage of Force lightning at them. Both Maul and Savage were able to hold back the lightning blast, but Maul broke the stalemate and retaliated telekinetically, forcing Sidious to drop his weapons; Savage, however, was temporarily paralyzed from his efforts to block the assault. With Sidious pinned down against the wall, Maul slowly advancing, Sidious cackled and used the Force to drop the chandelier Maul was walking underneath. He barely rolled out of the way in time before it collapsed on him. Savage recovered, jumped and attempted the killing blow on Sidious, but Maul dropping his telekinesis allowed Sidious to drop in time. While Savage slid along the wall with his lightsaber, Sidious recovered his weapons and retreated, with Maul in close pursuit. The duel progressed out onto the Palace balcony, where, as Sidious and Maul crossed blades, Opress charged into the former, sending him flying. However, as Sidious fell, he [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force pulled]] the brothers from the balcony, and together they fell to the [[Sundari Royal Palace plaza/Legends|plaza]] below. As they landed, Opress ignited one end of his double-bladed weapon, stabbing it into the ground in a failed strike at Sidious. Sidious re-ignited his own blades, and counter-struck, but Opress ignited his lightsaber's second blade, blocking the blow. Both brothers tried to outmaneuver Sidious by attacking from his front and flank, but Sidious merely kicked Opress away when the brothers attacked. With Savage momentarily down, Maul attempted to finish the duel with an overhead power blow, but Sidious used the Force to push Maul into a stone wall, which he struck with enough force to cause him to temporarily lose consciousness. Sidious was now free to focus on defeating the hulking Opress. Opress charged with his lightsaber, but Sidious, with lightsabers disengaged, merely toyed with the Zabrak as he dodged a few clumsy strikes. As Sidious activated his blades and locked with Savage, he struck at full velocity. As Maul awoke, Sidious paralyzed the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak's]] arms with well-placed kicks before impaling him with both lightsabers, while sneering and cackling at a horrified Maul. After mortally wounding Opress, Sidious threw him off the courtyard into the street below using the Force. He then allowed Maul to run past him to the fallen Opress. As the wounded Zabrak died, the [[Dathomir Magic|enhancements]] provided by Mother [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] dissipated in a green mist that swirled around the brothers. With his last breath, he communicated his regret that he was never worthy to be an apprentice to Maul, due to their differing personalities. As Maul knelt over the body of his fallen brother, Sidious spoke, reminding him of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] millennium-old [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]]: there could only ever be two Sith Lords at a time. He revealed that Maul had been [[Dooku/Legends|replaced]] after his defeat, before he jumped down to continue the duel. [[File:ShallWeDance-TL.png|thumb|right|250px|Maul faces his former Master after his brother's death]] Enraged, Maul ignited the [[Darksaber/Legends|darksaber]] and engaged Sidious once again. His use of [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]] at first were able to rival the elder Sith until the two entered a bladelock. Sidious overpowered Maul and forced his blades down towards the hilts of Maul's sabers, before forcing them apart and away. He finished the duel by telekinetically flinging Maul against a stone mural before depositing the broken Maul at his feet. Despite Maul's pleas for mercy, he stated that among the Sith there was no mercy, then started to torture Maul with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. As Maul screamed in pain, Sidious told him that he would not be killed, as the Sith Lord had other plans for his former apprentice, while sporting a triumphant smile. ==Aftermath== Kenobi survived his transit off-world and continued to faithfully serve the Republic throughout the remainder of the conflict, only to go into hiding following the [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the start of the Imperials' subsequent [[Great Jedi Purge|Jedi purge]].{{Film|III}} With the subjugation of Darth Maul at the hands of Darth Sidious, the Sith's Rule of Two was upheld, though its usage among the Sith would later wane in favor of Sidious' [[Rule of One (Palpatine's Doctrine)|Rule of One]], espousing the merits of his own singular power over the Sith Order,''[[Star Wars: Book of Sith]]'' and eventually the [[Rule of One|philosophy]] of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith]] Order.[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]] The New Mandalorian government was broken,[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']] destroyed by the Mandalorian revanchists''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' of the Death Watch. The pacifist faction's power faded as the Mandalorian warrior clans and their traditional culture returned to dominate Mandalorian society, while Sundari's place as an important hub of business on Mandalore declined, with most off-worlders preferring to do their business on Mandalore's [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]], or favoring the planet's traditional capital of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]]. Into the power gap that the Collective's dissolution left, stepped the forces of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]]. The criminal syndicate established a presence on Mandalore as well as its [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]]; these operations were overseen by Black Sun [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Tyno Fabris]], who worked out of an office at the ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], in Keldabe. The removal of Maul from Mandalorian politics also allowed Death Watch to make use of Almec as their own puppet in his role of Prime Minister of the New Mandalorians, though the New Mandalorians' power as a faction was in decline as the Mandalorian warrior clans returned to their former prominence under the rule of [[Spar|Mandalore the Resurrector]] and Death Watch's own presence grew. ==Behind the scenes== The battle of Sundari first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in ''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]'', a young-reader novel [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Jason Fry]] and published by [[Scholastic]] on [[January 1]], [[2013]]. The novel adapts the events of four episodes from the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', including "[[Revival (episode)|Revival]]," "[[Eminence (episode)|Eminence]]," "[[Shades of Reason]]," and "[[The Lawless]]." The episode "The Lawless" depicts the events of the Sundari battle on screen, though its ending is notably different from the one presented in the ''Shadow Conspiracy'' novel in one significant aspect: while the novel suggests Darth Sidious kills the defeated Darth Maul, the episode clearly indicates Maul is to be spared for Sidious' unknown purposes. ==Appearances== *''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]'' {{1st}} *{{TCW|The Lawless}} *[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 1|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 1]] {{Mo}} *[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 2|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 2]] {{Imo}} *[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 3|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 3]] {{Mo}} *[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']] {{Imo}} ==Sources== *{{InsiderCite|142|The Show That Changed Star Wars|The Show That Changed ''Star Wars''}} *{{SWE|groups|mandalorian-super-commando|Mandalorian super commando}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Batalla de Sundari |pl=Bitwa o Sundari }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Mandalore, battle of}} [[Category:Battles of Mandalore]] [[Category:Events during the Clone Wars]]
